name: Cryptopia
rootCause: On February 1, 2021, while under liquidation, Cryptopia suffered a theft of approximately $45,000 worth of Stakenet (XSN) tokens from a dormant cold wallet controlled by liquidators. This incident exploited custodial wallet access, though no technical forensic detail is available. The precise root cause is unconfirmed, but the theft relied on access to a cold wallet held by liquidators, likely through key compromise or unauthorized access. No technical vector or chain transaction detail is published.
